sources.title: SigLIP2 - vLLM Ascend
sources.snippet: SigLIP2 1 Introduction ¶ SigLIP2 is a family of vision-language embedding models from Google. Each checkpoint provides separate text and image encoders for contrastive embedding (not text generation). vLLM runs SigLIP2 as a pooling model via llm.embed () (offline) or /v1/embeddings (online).
